QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_42

question.text: Kanchan AIF has a Fund XIRR of 24% and the pace-matched public index XIRR is 16%. What is the Direct Alpha?

explanation.text: The Logic: Direct Alpha = Fund IRR − Pace-matched Market IRR = 24% − 16% = 8%. Direct Alpha is quoted as an annualised percentage (not a multiple). Per Section 7.3.6, this is the variation on KS-PME that directly quantifies annualised outperformance. The Trap: 40% adds the two. 1.50x is the ratio — that's something closer to KS-PME concept, not Direct Alpha. 0.67x is the inverse. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests identical formula. Global PE benchmarking (Cambridge, PitchBook) reports Direct Alpha alongside KS-PME.
